source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. CPU Common Options → MCA error thresh enable: TRUE c. CPU Common Options → MCA error thresh count: FFE (Deviate from default setting FF5) d. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → ECC Configuration → DRAM UECC Retry: Enabled e. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → Disable Memory Error Injection: False f. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enabled 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Confirm UMC::RecCtrl::RecEn[2]=1 to enable retry on UECC errors in HDT. 6. Execute the following command to get list if valid UMC. sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest –-listvalidumc 7. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --dramothererrors --errortype 2 --socketdieumc 0:0:3 --enablemcapolling 0 --errormode 0 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. For uncorrectable errors, verify that the errors are logged correctly in BERT dmesg after the warm reset is triggered. 3. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 4. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed.
